question: During whose reign did Timur invaded India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nasiruddin Mahmud Shah.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com
/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Timur invaded India in the year **1398.**
 
• Under the reign of '**Tughlaq Sultan Nasiruddin Mahmud Shah'.**
 
• He invaded India **to destroy and plunder the massive wealth of India.**
 
• He attacked India to fight a **"Holy war"** against the infidels.
 
• **To destroy** the** temples and the idols** and make people believe in **Islam.**
